title: Use case walks: every StRS path shows Tested by and Accepted by
summary: P1. Every declared path of every StRS shows Tested by and Accepted by (owner). At b9b29c5a, 150 of 156 paths lack a simulated walk, 134 an acceptance; 59 of 68 StRS with no walk have a partial test. One change per e2e group, mode switch last.
